name: Racoon Works Hua Wei CC 2
tagline: Compares several scheduling algorithms to order AI operators under memory limits, recomputing results to cut peaks.

awards: Huawei Custom Challenge #2: Automatic Decision for Re-computation

problem: The sponsor asked for an execution order that minimises compute time under a memory cap.
solution: Implements naive, greedy, heuristic, beam-search and branch-and-bound schedulers, freeing intermediates aggressively and recomputing nodes to lower the memory peak.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Huawei Custom Challenge #2: Automatic Decision for Re-computation” among 217 submissions.
Took a multi-algorithm approach drawn from recent research.

lessons: Comparing several algorithms shows judges you understand the problem.
